newsitem.title: ESTONIA: ESTONIA-TALLINN HEATING TO ISSUE NEW CPS, OTHERS FOLLOW.
newsitem.headline: ESTONIA-TALLINN HEATING TO ISSUE NEW CPS, OTHERS FOLLOW.

text.p: Tallinna Soojus (Tallinn Heating) will issue three-year commercial papers worth 85 million kroons on April 30, Hoiupank said on Friday.
The yield of the commercial papers is 8.45 percent, Otto Tamme, head of Hoiupank's money and capital department, told Reuters.
Tallinn Water and Sewage Company will also issue new commercial papers on April 29 but the amount has not yet been fixed, Tamme said.
In May, Parnu and Tartu city governments are due to issue their commercial papers, Tamme added.
